summary.text: You can use your MediSave to pay CareShield Life premiums for your family members.

details.heading: Another way to pay
details.body: You or your family member may top up your or their MediSave using the Top up MediSave Account online form.

steps.name: Apply to pay
steps.text: Visit the Change Premium Payer e-Service. Log in using Singpass and complete the application.

example_phrasings: Can I help my family members pay for their CareShield Life premiums?
Can I pay my family's CareShield Life premiums?
How can I help pay a family member's premiums?

sources.page_title: Can I help my family members pay for their CareShield Life premiums?

quotes.text: You can pay the CareShield Life premiums for your family members (i.e. spouse, parents, children, siblings or grandparents) using your MediSave.
To do so, you can visit the Change Premium Payer e-Service and log in using Singpass to complete the application.
Alternatively, you/your family member may top up to your or his/her MediSave via the Top up MediSave Account online form.
